chunks: When he said to his father and his people: "What is this you worship?"
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Ibrahim say to his father and people regarding their idols?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah As-Saffat, Prophet Ibrahim (AS) confronts his father and community with a rhetorical challenge to the validity of their idolatry, marking a pivotal moment in the establishment of Tawhid. Shia scholarship often highlights this as an early example of intellectual debate and the rejection of ancestral tradition in favor of divine reason. The verse underscores the prophetic duty to call others to monotheism even amidst familial and societal pressure.
